storage: one gzipped JSONL per calendar day OBSERVED (not event date — events span 2019-present) under <archive>/dtccswaps/; append-only, deduped by Dissemination Identifier across ALL previously archived days (the upstream file is cumulative-from-inception and re-serves every prior event daily, so day-over-day new volume for the in-scope US subset is typically low hundreds to low thousands of rows)
written_by: server/dtccSwaps.ts refreshDtccSwaps (6h poll, self-healing since the source is cumulative; eager boot)
source: DTCC SEC-regulated security-based swap data repository, kgc0418-tdw-data-0.s3.amazonaws.com/sec/eod/SEC_CUMULATIVE_EQUITIES_YYYY_MM_DD.zip — keyless, daily, ~132MB zip / ~1.15GB CSV, ~2.0M rows/day GLOBAL (probed live 2026-08-22, HTTP 200, single-member deflate zip). VOLUME-BUDGET SCOPE (this session's build decision, filed per data_census.md census #2 item 2 'needs its own budget decision before build'): archives US-UNDERLIER rows ONLY (Underlier ID source = CUSIP, or ISIN with a US country prefix) — ~5.7% of rows live-measured 2026-08-22 (112,612 of 1,981,839). The raw zip is still fetched and streamed in full every poll (bandwidth only — a dependency-free streaming zip reader in server/dtccSwaps.ts holds only the local-file-header bytes in memory, never the 1.15GB decompressed body, so RSS stays bounded in the same process as the trading loop); only the US-filtered subset is written to disk. Basket-swap rows (semicolon-joined multi-ISIN source field, ~0.003% of the US-flagged sample) are dropped in v1 rather than attributed a guessed country.
license: SEC-mandated public dissemination (Reg SBSR real-time reporting) — attribution required, informational use
attribution: DTCC Security-Based Swap Data Repository (SBSDR), SEC-regulated real-time dissemination

field_map.disseminationId — dedup key: Dissemination Identifier; unique per lifecycle event (NEWT/MODI/TERM/CORR/EROR/REVI)
field_map.originalDisseminationId: links an amendment/correction back to the event it modifies
field_map.actionType/eventTimestamp/effectiveDate: lifecycle event type and its timestamps
field_map.notionalAmountLeg1 — nullable: USD-or-native notional; null means blank/masked in the source (Dodd-Frank real-time reporting caps mask very large notionals) — never fabricated as 0
field_map.underlierId/underlierIdSource: CUSIP or ISIN identifying the underlying equity; ONLY CUSIP or US-prefixed-ISIN rows are archived (see source note)
field_map.underlierName: UPI Underlier Name — free-text issuer/security description from the vendor's UPI reference data

confidence_model: RAW SEC-mandated dissemination data. GATE 1 (DATA) PASSED 2026-08-22 (scripts/dtcc_swaps_gate1.ts): two independent external checksum standards (ISO 6166 ISIN check digit, CUSIP Global Services mod-10 check digit on the CUSIP embedded in every US ISIN) both scored effectively 100% on the live US-underlier subset, confirming the column-by-header-name extraction reads genuine identifiers rather than a misaligned column. The fresh-large-TRS-notional-on-small/mid-caps positioning hypothesis stays gate-2-locked: blocked on accumulating archive depth (same precedent as every other freshly-archived root in signal_ladder.json), no forward-return test attempted yet.
entity_key: disseminationId (verified unique — DTCC's own field, one row per lifecycle event)
cadence: daily source (cumulative-from-2019-09-12, re-served in full each day); 6h poll, self-healing by design since re-fetching the cumulative file naturally catches any missed day
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). DATA CENSUS master ranking #11 — the one root explicitly gated on a volume-budget decision before build; this session's US-only scoping decision fulfills that gate (also logged in research/wishlist.md and research/experiments.md) rather than requiring the full 147MB/day/1.24GB-CSV global archive.
ticker_resolution: underlierId/underlierIdSource carry only a raw CUSIP/ISIN, not a ticker. server/cusipResolver.ts (built 2026-08-22, follow-up session — item (3) from this root's own GATE 1 NEXT queue) resolves CUSIP -> ticker via OpenFIGI's free public mapping API, cached forever (positive AND negative results) so a CUSIP is queried at most once ever. scripts/dtcc_resolve_cusips.ts is the re-runnable driver: reads every archived row, derives one CUSIP per row (raw CUSIP source rows pass through; US-ISIN source rows via the existing cusipFromUsIsin), resolves the never-seen subset, writes <archive>/dtccswaps/cusip_ticker_cache.json. Not wired into the boot-time poll — resolution is a third-party HTTP dependency this process's trading loop must never block on, so it stays a standalone script, same posture as dtcc_swaps_gate1.ts. Live-validated against 15 real CUSIPs pulled from the 2026-08-21 file: 14/15 resolved to correct real tickers (COST, JPM's ETF, CMCSA, SYK, RIVN, etc. — DTCC's own free-text UPI name cross-checked by eye against each OpenFIGI hit); the one miss (5E1Q82955) also carries no DTCC name, consistent with a non-common-equity/private instrument OpenFIGI genuinely has no ticker for, not a resolver defect. Not yet run against the full archive (no archive exists yet in production — the DTCC poll's first backfill had not landed as of this session, /api/data/dtcc-swaps still reporting warming_up).
